bounds_argument: Let N=endIndex-startIndex, b=log2Base in {1,3,4}, B=N*b and L=ceil(B/16). Digit k has bitOffset=k*b, 0<=k<N, so segment=floor(k*b/16)<L. A nonzero residual requires k*b mod 16+b>16, hence (segment+1)*16<(k+1)*b<=B and segment+1<L. Digits are validated for their base by the scanner. Division writes descend from L-1 to zero. Length remains fixed; zero-length case performs no indexed writes. Argument assumes valid scanner-produced literal and allocatable sizes; generated tests are witnesses, not a proof for arbitrary malformed direct callers.
